stories.title: Richard Pilling
stories.subTitle: WICKET-KEEPER OF THE YEAR - 1891
stories.summary: Richard Pilling was born at Bedford on July 5, 1855, and, so far as we are aware, it was not until many years later that he became associated with Lancashire-the only county with which he has had any cricket connection
